global_rules.point_in_time: Every observable must be a pure function of records with available_at no later than detection_cutoff.
global_rules.window_separation: Antecedent and detection observations cannot also serve as future outcome labels.
global_rules.unknown: Missing clock, revision, sequence, mapping or coverage yields UNKNOWN, ABSTAIN or CENSORED, not zero.
global_rules.measurement_totality: ER denominator equal to zero or any non-finite ER input returns UNKNOWN_ZERO_PATH_LENGTH or UNKNOWN_INVALID_INPUT; RVOL historical median less than or equal to zero, non-comparable units, insufficient history or any non-finite input returns UNKNOWN_ZERO_OR_MISSING_BASE or UNKNOWN_INVALID_INPUT. Such values cannot update state, score, path or permission.
global_rules.probability: Ordinal support cannot be named probability before frozen out-of-sample calibration.
global_rules.ordinal_aggregation: E0 path instances start at zero; unregistered priors and weights are forbidden. Each dependency group uses PAR-EVIDENCE-AGGREGATOR, is bounded by PAR-EVIDENCE-GROUP-CAP, and the accumulated ordinal score is bounded by PAR-EVIDENCE-TOTAL-CAP. Decay uses PAR-EVIDENCE-HALF-LIFE with exp(-ln(2)*age/half_life).
global_rules.machine_predicate_readiness: Natural-language hard falsifiers and expiry rules are design inputs only. Until each is replaced by a versioned observable/operator/threshold/clock/window/censoring/terminal predicate, its status is NOT_YET_EXECUTABLE_BLOCKS_D3_E2.
global_rules.ev_outcome_partition: Numeric EV requires a versioned mutually exclusive and exhaustive ActionOutcome partition, nonnegative conditional probabilities summing to one, retained OTHER/UNKNOWN residual, and out-of-sample calibration; otherwise EV is UNKNOWN and cannot authorize action.
global_rules.common_denominator: Comparators use one outcome-free master opportunity universe and report selective coverage.
global_rules.first_hit: Ambiguous same-bin target and stop uses STOP_FIRST or is censored according to a preregistered rule.
global_rules.negative_evidence: Negative and inconclusive results remain linked to the exact candidate version.

contracts.decision_relevance: Blocks every downstream measurement if causal-clock or revision eligibility fails.
contracts.antecedent_window: All source versions whose available_at is no later than decision_at.
contracts.outcome_window: Leakage audit of generated information set.
contracts.comparator: Naive latest-value replay, permitted only as an explicitly contaminated control.
contracts.label_contract: PASS only if no selected version crosses decision_at and revision selection is deterministic.
contracts.support_rule: Eligible replay passes all future-time and revision mutations.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Any later version changes a prior decision feature.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: available_at > decision_at for any consumed record.
contracts.censoring: Unknown source time makes the affected record ineligible.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Synthetic mutation closure first; real coverage is evaluated source by source.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: STOP on causal violation; WAIT_DATA when authoritative clocks are unavailable.
contracts.evidence_claim_boundary: Contract correctness only; no market claim.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests whether added timeframes improve state and action decisions enough to justify complexity.
contracts.detection_cutoff: Each role's last eligible closed bar.
contracts.antecedent_window: Past windows declared by timeframe profile.
contracts.comparator: Single-timeframe state and a simpler two-timeframe state.
contracts.label_contract: Direction, phase, UNKNOWN and transition labels with no future-bar construction.
contracts.support_rule: Stable out-of-sample improvement in state and decision metrics at comparable coverage.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Added roles only increase delay, instability or selection.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Simpler profile is non-inferior on preregistered metrics and complexity.
contracts.censoring: Stale context, unfinished bars and gaps are UNKNOWN.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report samples by state, timeframe and transition; no aggregate-only claim.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: WAIT_DATA until every compared role has sufficient qualified coverage.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests whether location removes low-edge decisions rather than merely describing charts.
contracts.detection_cutoff: Before current position and future reaction are observed.
contracts.confirmation_window: NONE for position; strength and consumption require separate future contracts.
contracts.comparator: No-zone state, exact-point zone, shifted zone and random zone.
contracts.label_contract: Same outcome universe for all zone variants.
contracts.support_rule: Reduced middle-location errors or improved outcome distribution without selective coverage.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Random or shifted zones perform equivalently.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Simpler or placebo zone is non-inferior across qualified states.
contracts.censoring: Invalid width, future-derived anchor or missing volatility is NO_VALID_ZONE.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report by source type, zone age, state and position bin.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: WAIT when no valid zone; reject any zone using outcome reaction.

contracts.decision_relevance: Determines whether RSI deserves inclusion as a conditional trigger feature.
contracts.detection_cutoff: Trigger bar close with all higher-role facts already eligible.
contracts.confirmation_window: Separate structural trigger after RSI observation.
contracts.comparator: Structure+position; plus fixed RSI; plus conditional RSI; full candidate without RSI.
contracts.label_contract: Same entry opportunity, outcome barriers, cost and horizon across ablations.
contracts.support_rule: Conditional RSI adds stable out-of-sample information and net decision value.
contracts.contradiction_rule: RSI is redundant, unstable or only works after selection.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: No stable same-universe increment after costs and multiplicity adjustment.
contracts.censoring: Insufficient RSI history or unknown state is UNKNOWN_RSI_CONTEXT.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report by state, side, timeframe and RSI bin with minimum support.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Never EXECUTE from RSI alone; WAIT_DATA if state-stratified support is inadequate.
contracts.evidence_claim_boundary: Feature increment, not standalone signal validity.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests the core distinction between pressure continuation and absorption.
data_requirements: sequenced L2 updates or an explicitly adequate alternative
contracts.antecedent_window: Pressure and immediate impact ending at cutoff.
contracts.comparator: Pressure-only, price-volume-wick baseline and no-resilience model.
contracts.label_contract: Observable path outcome; mechanism identity is not a truth label.
contracts.support_rule: Strict resilience adds stable discrimination over all controls.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Resilience proxy is unavailable, overlaps outcome or adds no increment.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Qualified strict-sequence data show no stable increment over pressure-only controls.
contracts.censoring: Any sequence gap crossing pressure, response or outcome produces CENSORED_GAP.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Require side, depth, state and event coverage; aggregated percentage-depth snapshots are ineligible for strict R.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: WAIT_DATA until strict response observability and adequate coverage are proven.
contracts.evidence_claim_boundary: January proxy result is descriptive/inconclusive and cannot support or falsify strict R.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests contextual increment from leverage without pretending to identify actors.
contracts.confirmation_window: NONE unless a separate path confirmation is declared.
contracts.support_rule: Leverage family adds stable path or risk information.
contracts.contradiction_rule: No increment or result depends on one venue/state.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Qualified ablation shows no stable increment after transport controls.
contracts.censoring: Unit, contract or cross-venue clock mismatch is INELIGIBLE.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report by venue, contract, side and state.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: WAIT_DATA on unknown silence, unit or coverage; never infer exact opening/closing intent.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests whether organizing uncertainty improves forecasts and actions.
contracts.antecedent_window: State, position and eligible evidence only.
contracts.confirmation_window: Predeclared path updates before cutoff only.
contracts.comparator: Same-information single narrative and simple direction classifier.
contracts.label_contract: Mutually exclusive observable scenarios plus censored.
contracts.support_rule: Improves proper score, error elimination or net decision value at comparable coverage.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Improvement comes only from abstaining on difficult cases or added complexity.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Simpler comparator is non-inferior after coverage-risk and complexity accounting.
contracts.censoring: Unobservable or gapped outcome is CENSORED, not OTHER_PATH.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report all opportunities and selective coverage; no favorable subset.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Stop adding paths when coverage rule is met; WAIT on no testable path.
contracts.evidence_claim_boundary: Decision-system increment, not proof of any mechanism.

contracts.decision_relevance: Prevents correlated indicators from creating false confidence.
contracts.antecedent_window: Eligible evidence items and declared groups.
contracts.comparator: Naive sum, max-absolute, representative-variable and group-regularized models.
contracts.support_rule: Better reliability/tail calibration without material coverage loss.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Grouping loses information or only lowers confidence without calibration benefit.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: No out-of-sample calibration benefit across preregistered aggregation variants.
contracts.censoring: Unknown dependency mapping blocks probability update.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Require enough forecasts per probability bin and state.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: WAIT until scenario probabilities are legitimately calibrated.

contracts.decision_relevance: Generalizes experience-derived sequences without imposing a fixed day count.
contracts.antecedent_window: Past state needed to activate the event.
contracts.outcome_window: Resolution after the last confirmation step.
contracts.comparator: Fixed-duration template and simpler FSM at equal information.
contracts.label_contract: Path completion, alternative completion, expiry or censored.
contracts.support_rule: More stable out-of-sample recognition and outcome information.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Boundary selection leaks outcomes or fixed/simple model is non-inferior.
contracts.censoring: Gap or unresolved order is CENSORED/EXPIRED.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report every activated event and path length distribution.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Reject outcome-selected starts; never force missing steps.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests the absorption/transition branch of the user-derived methodology.
contracts.detection_cutoff: End of shock candidate; future response excluded.
contracts.outcome_window: Later upward transition, balance, continuation or expiry.
contracts.comparator: Continuation, balance, shifted zone and volume-wick baseline.
contracts.support_rule: Registered sequence improves transition discrimination without actor-intent claims.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Zone loss, failed reclaim or no incremental information.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Effective structural loss and failed reclaim within the frozen window.
contracts.censoring: Corporate/contract event, gap or missing volume mapping censors the episode.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report by state, zone source and shock magnitude.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: WAIT for response confirmation; one candle never suffices.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests temporary rebound failure without assuming who covered or bought.
contracts.antecedent_window: Prior down state and rebound shock.
contracts.confirmation_window: Acceptance failure, event-VWAP loss or lower high.
contracts.outcome_window: Later downside continuation, transition, balance or expiry.
contracts.label_contract: Observable path, not a short-cover identity label.
contracts.support_rule: Failure sequence improves downside continuation discrimination.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Accepted higher low/upward transition or no increment.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Predeclared upward transition is accepted and maintained.
contracts.censoring: Unknown event clock or contract mapping removes event features.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report event and non-event rebounds separately.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: No short action before registered failure confirmation.

contracts.decision_relevance: Preserves the non-directional path and middle-location no-trade outcome.
contracts.label_contract: Balance persists, upward break, downward break, expiry or censored.
contracts.support_rule: Identifies a distinct distribution and reduces middle-location errors.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Boundaries are hindsight-selected or direction baseline is non-inferior.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Immediate accepted directional expansion invalidates the balance episode.
contracts.censoring: Invalid boundaries or gap across them is CENSORED.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report boundary and middle opportunities separately.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Middle location is WAIT in the candidate policy.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests the tail path that repeated tests weaken rather than strengthen support.
contracts.detection_cutoff: Each touch before its reaction window.
contracts.outcome_window: Later downside expansion, reclaim or expiry.
contracts.comparator: Absorption, simple touch count and random-zone controls.
contracts.label_contract: Break-fail-reclaim, reclaim, no break, expiry or censored.
contracts.support_rule: Declining response quality plus failed reclaim improves tail-path discrimination.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Large selling fails to depress price and reclaim quality rises.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Rapid accepted reclaim and higher-low transition.
contracts.censoring: Unknown lower liquidity or barrier-crossing gap is CENSORED.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Require enough distinct zones, not repeated rows from one episode.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: No anticipatory short before effective break and failed reclaim.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests event reaction as risk/state context, not headline-based direction.
contracts.comparator: Matched non-event periods and state-only risk gate.
contracts.label_contract: Tail risk, acceptance/failure and opportunity cost; direction alpha is separate.
contracts.support_rule: Improves preregistered risk/state metric after opportunity cost.
contracts.contradiction_rule: No increment, invalid publication clock or current-vintage leakage.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Qualified matched evaluation shows no risk/state benefit and higher opportunity cost.
contracts.censoring: Unknown publication time or revision is INELIGIBLE.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report by event class and avoid pooling unlike releases.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: WAIT_DATA until one bounded source passes D1-D2 PIT verification.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests whether past similar states add information without visual hindsight.
contracts.antecedent_window: Only neighbors ending before purge boundary.
contracts.comparator: State-group base rate and no-analog model.
contracts.label_contract: Same scenario labels as the query.
contracts.support_rule: Stable out-of-sample increment across distance and neighbor neighborhoods.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Leakage, unstable neighbor choice or no baseline increment.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Purged analog is non-inferior or worse across preregistered parameter neighborhoods.
contracts.censoring: No sufficient eligible neighbors returns UNKNOWN.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Use effective sample size and shrink small groups.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Defer until simpler state/path models are stable.

contracts.decision_relevance: Tests dynamic stop/target management under monotone risk.
data_requirements: same-entry E2 trades and E3 fills later
contracts.antecedent_window: Locked trade thesis and eligible post-fill facts.
contracts.comparator: Fixed stop/target, no extension and simple trailing stop.
contracts.label_contract: Same entry and price path for counterfactual policies.
contracts.support_rule: Improves net outcome/tail risk without increasing worst allowed risk.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Overtrading, cost erosion or narrow-parameter dependence.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Simpler frozen policy is non-inferior after costs and tail risk.
contracts.censoring: Unknown fill/order state blocks management evaluation.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report same-entry paired differences and policy namespace.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Synthetic tests may verify monotonicity only; market claim waits for E2/E3.
contracts.evidence_claim_boundary: Risk invariant now; economic value untested.

contracts.decision_relevance: Prevents market forecast quality from being confused with executable net value.
contracts.comparator: Conservative flat-cost and zero-cost diagnostic controls.
contracts.support_rule: Execution decomposition changes ranking and improves realized calibration.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Simpler model is non-inferior across exact venue/order states.
contracts.censoring: Unknown order or unreconciled position is SUSPEND/CENSORED.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Report by order type, size, liquidity and latency.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: DORMANT until E3; candles cannot substitute for fills.

contracts.decision_relevance: Final test of whether the full complexity adds value.
contracts.comparator: Simple trend, range, structure-only and no-trade baselines.
contracts.label_contract: Frozen scenario and action outcomes with censoring.
contracts.support_rule: Stable unseen net decision improvement after cost, risk and multiplicity.
contracts.contradiction_rule: Simpler model is non-inferior or complexity is unstable.
contracts.hard_falsifier_rule: Qualified one-time holdout shows no stable net benefit over simpler baselines.
contracts.censoring: Any component/data/permission failure makes the opportunity ineligible or WAIT.
contracts.power_and_coverage: Predeclare support by state, side and action; no aggregate-only pass.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Test last; simplify if no stable increment.
contracts.evidence_claim_boundary: System validity remains untested until an E2 gate.

contracts.contradiction_rule: The user clarification contradicts the fixed-duration reading.
contracts.stop_wait_rule: Never test or trade this formulation.
